payload.stem: A sled starts from rest and speeds up at a constant rate along a straight, level track. It travels $80\text{ m}$ in the first $6\text{ s}$ of its motion. What is the speed of the sled at the end of those $6\text{ s}$?

options.why: Reports the average speed $d/t$ as the final speed, forgetting that the speed was growing steadily from zero.
With constant acceleration from rest the average speed is half the final speed, so $d=\tfrac12vt$ and $v=2d/t=2(80)/(6)=26.7\text{ m/s}$.
Halves the average speed instead of doubling it, $d/(2t)$.
Uses $v=\sqrt{2d/t}$ by mixing the kinematic equations.
